newsitem.title: JAPAN: TABLE - Japan June retail sales fall 2.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Japan June retail sales fall 2.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's retail sales fell 2.3 percent in June from a year earlier, declining for the third month in a row, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry said on Wednesday.
Overall sales increased 3.4 percent from a year earlier.
The following is a breakdown of the figures:
large-scale stores -0.9 pct (1.82 trln yen) -3.3 pct
Note: Large-scale stores refers to department stores and supermarkets, while the retail sales category also includes car dealerships and smaller stores.
